subject: logic
title: Does it follow?
blurb: Judge whether a conclusion is valid.

items.prompt: All dogs bark. Rex is a dog. Conclusion: Rex barks. Is this valid?
All cats have tails. This animal has a tail. Conclusion: it is a cat. Valid?
choices: No — other animals have tails too
